data_description.invert_power: Flip the sign of the phase and total power readings. Use this when the meter shows negative power while drawing power, e.g. because the in/out wires or clamps are reversed.
data_description.swap_import_export: Report the meter's export counters as import and vice versa (active and reactive). Note: the counter values jump when you change this, which Home Assistant's long-term statistics will record.
